Facts taken from page 6:
- **Outpatient X-rays:** $50 copay, with no setting named, so setting is `any`.
- **Diagnostic mammogram:** $0 copay, with no setting named, so setting is `any`.
- **Other diagnostic radiology in an outpatient hospital:** $500 copay. The row describes this as "all other diagnostic radiology services," and the example services are MRI and CAT scan. I record it under `imaging.diagnostic` rather than a narrower benefit.
- **Other diagnostic radiology in all other locations:** $200 copay. The setting here is "all other locations," which does not match any listed setting, so I leave this cost out.

Each quote must occur exactly once on its page. "$50 copay" appears more than once on page 6 (genetic testing), so I use the X-ray row text "Outpatient X-rays $50 copay". The mammogram line and the $500 line are each unique.
